findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "contract-auditor" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "crypto" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: contract-auditor, market-predictor, clarification-impact · Private data: contract-auditor, token-trap-detector, milestone-verifier, cover-claim, vault-exit-lawyer, token-due-diligence, screen-tokens, token-vault-ladder · Public sink: milestone-verifier · Destructive: token-vault-ladder.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: contract-auditor, market-predictor, clarification-impact · Private data: contract-auditor, token-trap-detector, milestone-verifier, cover-claim, vault-exit-lawyer, token-due-diligence, screen-tokens, token-vault-ladder · Public sink: milestone-verifier · Destructive: token-vault-ladder

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
